actors.name: Donald Trump
actors.blurb: Donald Trump dominates right-wing news coverage through midterm campaign rallies across New York, Texas, and Alaska, along with high-profile policy announcements regarding Iran and AI regulations. His administration faces multiple legal challenges while implementing aggressive crackdowns on tech worker green card programs and foreign student visas.
